description: 국토교통부_도로운송수송실적 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 도로운송수송실적은 전국 시도 간 화물 운송량을 집계한 데이터로, 출발지-목적지(O/D)별 운송수송실적과 품목별 화물수송실적 및 (시도)기점을 기준으로하는 품목별 O/D 물동량 정보를. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 화물운송 실적, 운송수단, 화물운송 현황, 시도별실적, 품목별실적. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2025-06-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
